PBPC transplantation is an important and valuable tool for haemato-oncological patients, and it has become a standard method in many centres.

PBPCs can be used successfully for the treatment of breast cancer patients, and the advantages of this source of stem cells should be considered when selecting the appropriate stem cell graft for the patient.
the use of PBPCs is a safe and effective means of supporting patients undergoing high-dose chemotherapy for breast cancer.
the PBPC transplantation is an effective and safe procedure for breast cancer patients.

the leukapheresis process is safe, and the quality of PBPCs is excellent, with high CD34(+) cell content and low contamination with tumour cells.
PBPCs have been successfully used in a number of clinical settings and that they have become the mainstay of haematopoiesis following high-dose chemotherapy.
